title: Stat
description: A measured figure with its label and direction of change, carried by a drawn mark rather than by colour

props.name: label
props.description: Stat: label naming the displayed measure.

props.name: value
props.description: Stat: value content supplied by the caller; no numeric formatting is inferred.

props.name: unit
props.description: Stat: optional unit beside the value.

props.name: note
props.description: Stat: optional supporting text below the value.

props.name: size
props.description: Stat: value size treatment; defaults to md.

props.name: delta
props.description: Stat: caller-supplied change direction and text, with optional emphasis.

props.name: variant
props.description: StatGroup only: group layout and separators; defaults to default.
